# DM to Store

> Freelance web design service for Instagram sellers in Jodhpur, India.
> We turn Instagram DM-based businesses into real, fast, mobile-first websites
> that let customers browse a full catalogue and order on WhatsApp in two taps.

## Services

- **Starter** (₹2,999 one-time): 1-page mobile website, up to 12 products, WhatsApp order buttons, ready in ~2 days
- **Boutique** (₹8,999 one-time): Multi-page site, up to 40 products, domain, basic SEO, ready in 3–4 days
- **Store** (₹24,999 onwards): Full online shop with UPI/card payments, cart, stock management
- **Care Plan** (₹799/month): Hosting, backups, up to 5 updates/month, cancel anytime

## Who we serve

Boutiques, home bakers, jewellery sellers, handmade & decor sellers, accessory brands — primarily Instagram-based small businesses in Jodhpur and across India.

## Technical

This site is built with Next.js and uses WhatsApp links for all customer interactions.
No user accounts, no tracking cookies, no analytics.
Fonts are self-hosted (next/font) — no Google Fonts CDN requests.
